Cache transfer is about how data moves between the cache and main memory. Role switching might refer to different roles (like decode or prefill) being assigned to different nodes. Batch completion could be when multiple requests are processed in parallel, leading to higher throughput but maybe higher latency.

GPU utilization is about how much GPU resources are being used, which affects both performance and power. Throughput tradeoffs involve balancing between processing power and data transfer rates.
